veranderings.voor: en ander klink as jy oor hulle skraap
veranderings.na: en ander instrumente klink as jy oor hulle skraap
veranderings.rede: Straight after the singular 'n Ratel, 'ander' can read as other rattles; naming instrumente makes the reference clear.

veranderings.na: uitgehol sodat dit soos 'n ronde pot lyk
veranderings.rede: 'Uithol tot 'n pot' reads wooden; saying it ends up looking like a round pot is more natural and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
veranderings.voor: 'n Speler hou een in elke hand
veranderings.na: 'n Speler hou een kalbas in elke hand
veranderings.rede: The previous sentence speaks of one hosho, so 'een' has no clear antecedent; naming the kalbas shows there are two.
'Sorteer' needs an object here; the protected 'ewe goeie maniere' stays intact.

veranderings.voor: Die hosho hoort weer by die kokonratels as jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, want albei word geskud.
veranderings.na: As jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, hoort die hosho weer by die kokonratels, want albei word geskud.
veranderings.rede: Putting the sorting question first mirrors the previous sentence (Volgens voorkoms ...) and makes the contrast clearer.

veranderings.voor: binne die familie en nie drie families nie
veranderings.na: binne die familie, nie drie families nie
veranderings.rede: A contrast with 'nie' reads more naturally without 'en'; same meaning.

veranderings.voor: sê of die maat gelyk gebly het
veranderings.na: sê of julle maat gehou het
veranderings.rede: 'Maat hou' is the established Afrikaans idiom for keeping time; 'die maat het gelyk gebly' is wooden.
'Los laat' is easily read as 'loslaat' (let go of); 'laat verslap' says plainly that the muscles relax.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The NIE list is split into single characters (t, w, e, e, -, ...), not whole wordings. If the script checks forbidden wordings against that list, single letters such as 'e' or 'n' would count as forbidden and could block almost any change. Looks like a tooling fault.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die instrumente in 'n familie is nie regtig familie van mekaar nie.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Same fault: the NIE list is split into single characters instead of the intended forbidden wording (probably 'enige herskrywing wat die woordspeling of regtig verwyder').

Same character split in the NIE list ('H, i, e, r, ...' instead of 'Hier by ons'). Also, the protected wording does not occur verbatim in the lesson: the text reads 'Party dansers in Suid-Afrika bind ratels'. That keeps the point of the entry (Suid-Afrika, not 'hier by ons'), so it was not changed, but the entry may be stale.
